subject.title: fix: restore Kiro usage refresh across CLI transports

question: After the code compatibility blockers are repaired, must this PR demonstrate a redacted authenticated Kiro usage refresh before merge, or is the controlled real-process matrix sufficient to waive account-dependent proof?
rationale: The contributor and current maintainer environment lack an approved authenticated Kiro account, so automation cannot establish the final provider-dependent behavior or safely decide whether that evidence may be waived.

options.title: Require authenticated proof
options.body: Keep the proof gate until an authorized user shows redacted exact-head quota and context refresh results with timing and process-cleanup confirmation.

options.title: Waive provider proof
options.body: Accept the controlled process matrix and logged-out real CLI run as sufficient once both code findings and focused regressions are resolved.

recommendation.title: Require authenticated proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proof gate until an authorized user shows redacted exact-head quota and context refresh results with timing and process-cleanup confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the exact-head maintainer repair and explicitly identified waiver of authenticated-provider proof as the remaining maintainer choice.
